_meta.why-custom: The throughput report is a per-person figure that only the reader group the organisation named may read, and every read is recorded on the audit trail. That check and that record live in WooReportController. An index page would read the generic OpenRegister object endpoint, which applies the register's own permissions and records nothing, so this is a custom page over the dossiq endpoint.

pages._note: Shown in the menu only while a report is offered to this user (initial state woo_reports, runtime woo.reportsOffered): the throughput report switched on and the user in its reader group, or the mail parties report switched on. The route stays reachable by URL; the screen draws only the halves on offer, and WooReportController and MailPartiesReportController refuse a read from anyone else.
